elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The General Liability Insurance per-occurrence limit remains an unspecified placeholder: "[***]."

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: The General Liability Insurance aggregate limit remains an unspecified placeholder: "[***] in the aggregate."

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative language requires Harpoon to maintain only USD 1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The record does not demonstrate that Harpoon does not process Customer Data, and the added operative language requires only USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: The clause requires statutory workers' compensation only under the laws of U.S. states where the Party has employees and expressly excludes Puerto Rico. No language covers all other jurisdictions where workers' compensation may be legally required, nor is their inapplicability demonstrated.

elements.element: Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance upon request.
elements.evidence: Section 11.6.2 requires either Party, including Harpoon, to provide certificates of insurance evidencing compliance upon the other Party's request.

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence states: "Harpoon shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of USD 1,000,000."

elements.element: Vendor shall maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The added operative sentence requires Harpoon to maintain "cyber and privacy liability insurance with a minimum limit of USD 2,000,000."

result.reason: The redline fully implements the two fallback coverage requirements but not the preferred limits. The addition is limited to the required fallback coverages and does not contradict or displace the existing insurance obligations. Drafting quality is reduced because the new coverage sentence is appended after Section 11.6.2 rather than incorporated into the numbered list of insurance types and minimum limits.
